# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>
- **Role:** school teacher  <sub>[v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
- **Titles:** master  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>; Mr.  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

## Personality

Mr. Phillips was frequently horrid and sarcastic toward his pupils. He possessed a dramatic flair, giving speeches and recitations in heart-stirring tones, though he could also be self-righteous when correcting bad behavior in others.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the school teacher in Avonlea. During his tenure, he regularly punished students, including whipping Sam Boulter—which led to an angry confrontation with Sam's father—and embarrassing Anne Shirley by holding up her slate and giving her public punishments. He paid special attention to Prissy Andrews under the guise of helping her with her lessons and openly courted her with gifts and verses. While teaching, he periodically engaged in sudden fits of strict reform, though he generally maintained poor discipline in his classroom. At an evening concert, he delivered Mark Antony's oration while gazing at Prissy. Before leaving Avonlea at the end of the term, he gave an emotional farewell speech that brought his students to tears.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_
